domains.name: Good Dogs co-op and authored media

contracts.failure_mode: An environment without an H.264 decoder attempts the authored movie and enters a retry or autoplay loop.
contracts.invariant: Playback eligibility is decided from MediaSource.isTypeSupported and HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType, never a user-agent string; unsupported environments remain at a visible PLAY/SKIP recovery surface.
contracts.spot_check: Stub both capability probes as unsupported; confirm no media source is loaded, VIDEO UNSUPPORTED — SKIP is visible, and campaign state is unchanged.

contracts.failure_mode: Media failure or missing decode advances the campaign without a completed movie or deliberate skip.
contracts.invariant: Only COMPLETED or USER_SKIPPED may settle a cutscene; capability failure is non-terminal and cannot write watched state.
contracts.spot_check: Open a cutscene with both probes unsupported and verify its promise remains pending until the explicit SKIP control is used.

contracts.failure_mode: A double tap, keyboard event, or late ended event applies cutscene completion more than once.
contracts.invariant: The first terminal event owns settlement; every later skip or completion event is a no-op and produces no second state write.
contracts.spot_check: Trigger skip twice and then emit ended; verify one result, one state write, and the same narrative state as a single skip.

contracts.failure_mode: A historical Felicia confrontation, boss, unlock, or day-ending route re-enters canonical Story Bible mode.
contracts.invariant: Canonical story mode fails closed across every historical route and Felicia becomes playable only after the ordered Act VI Duet reward.
contracts.spot_check: Load canonical mode with legacy Felicia save keys and call public legacy scene APIs; no retired scene, reward, or durable unlock may fire.

contracts.failure_mode: Day, Night, and Good Dogs retain duplicate presentation or input ownership after a handoff.
contracts.invariant: The production bootstrap installs one runtime mode shell and repeated enter/exit calls restore the exact owned surface and input snapshot once.
contracts.spot_check: Enter and exit Night twice from both title and Day; confirm one shell install, no held input, no duplicate blockers, and exact Day restoration.

deletion_ledger.removed: Early Felicia confrontation, secret-boss unlock, premature playable selection, and historical ending schedules in canonical mode.
deletion_ledger.reason: They conflict with the Story Bible v1.2 trust-to-alliance arc and ordered Act VI Duet reward.

deletion_ledger.removed: Automatic b736m8 canvas finale replay from completed standalone Good Dogs resumes.
deletion_ledger.reason: The authored Earthfall authority owns completion, persistence, replay, and return-to-title semantics.

deletion_ledger.removed: Independent mode handoff writes that left Day UI, held input, or ARIA blockers active beneath Night or Good Dogs.
deletion_ledger.reason: One reversible mode shell must own presentation and input boundaries.
